column1: # Bases that are near-invariant at their Sprinzl position (Biela et al. 2023).
# If a label drifts off its column, the base under it changes and the fraction
# drops, so each position gets a floor.
# Floors sit under the value measured on data/cyto/euk_gtrnadb.fa, 531 seqs.
# Failing means labels moved across seq positions.
# 21 has a low floor, and 19 is missing, because the D-loop is half fixed: short
# loops label correctly, full eight-base loops still put the GG on 17-18 instead
# of 18-19. Hoping to fix that and both go to 0.95.
# because sprinx tests do not label the CCA end.
